decisions.reason: The operator line complements the core garage door business and drives accessory revenue, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The solid wood door is a low-visibility niche variant, but it rounds out the one-source range at modest cost, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product despite uncertain results.
The remote-control operator supports door sales and demand for comfort, though model updates may eventually replace it, so it is kept for now.
Its overlap with Product F raises the chance of consolidation, but with industrial and logistics construction strong there is no performance shortfall that forces a drop.
As the lead glazed industrial door with its own page, it likely performs at or above aspiration and anchors the industrial portfolio.
